summary_en: Strike Group authorized acquisition of up to 3.0 million shares (5.2% of outstanding shares) for a maximum of 4.0 billion yen through open-market purchases on the Tokyo Stock Exchange from November 2, 2026 to August 31, 2027.
title_en: Notice Regarding Determination of Matters Related to Acquisition of Treasury Stock
translation_en_brief:
Strike Group's board of directors resolved on October 30, 2026 to acquire up to 3.0 million ordinary shares representing 5.2% of outstanding shares for a maximum of 4.0 billion yen through open-market purchases on the Tokyo Stock Exchange between November 2, 2026 and August 31, 2027.

The company cited record-high results in the fiscal year ended September 2026, planned revenue and profit growth for fiscal 2027, and confidence in sustained expansion of its core M&A brokerage business alongside new business initiatives. The current stock price level and financial position were also considered in the decision.

The company stated that the buyback, implemented while maintaining balance with growth investments, aims to enhance capital efficiency, expand shareholder returns, and improve mid-to-long-term shareholder value.
